Echeveria minima J. Meyrán, 1968.
姬莲，由J. Meyrán发表于1968年Series Secundae
Secundae系Distribution: Mexico (Hidalgo: Puente de Tasquillo)
分布于墨西哥Hidalgo州的Puente de TasquilloDescription (according to IHSP, 2003):
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem usually < 3 cm high, branching.
茎部：通常不高于3cm，多分枝。Rosette 3,5 – 4 cm in diameter.
莲座：3.5-4cm直径Leaves densely rosulate, obovate, prominently mucronate, 0,8 – 2 x 0,5 – 0,9 cm, 2 – 4 mm in diameter, glaucous green, margin and mucro reddened.
叶：形成密实的莲座；倒卵形，有明显的短尖，0.8-2cm长，0.5-0.9cm宽，2-4mm厚，绿色被霜。Inflorescences 1 – 4 per rosette, 1,2 – 3,5 cm long up to the first flower, cincinni 3 – 7 ( to 9-) flowered, pedicels 3 – 6 mm.
花序：每个莲座1-4根花序，到第一朵花1.2-3.5cm长，每个蝎尾状聚伞花序上3-7（可达9）朵花，花梗3.6mm。Flowers: Sepals expanding, corolla 8,5 – 11 x 5 – 7 mm in diameter near base, rose near base, yellow above.
花：花萼绽开，不贴花瓣；花冠8.5-11mm高，基部5-7cm直径；基部玫红色，上部黄色。Cytology : n = 28
染色体：n=28Distributed by ISI n°1014 (1977).
